name: MO-07
label: Safe R

key_factors: Incumbent Eric Burlison running with large financial edge
Democrat Missi Hesketh raised only ~$50k with no outside support
Prediction markets price Republican win at ~95%
model.rationale: This southwest Missouri seat carries a heavy Republican lean, and Burlison is an incumbent who has raised nearly $1.5 million against a Democratic challenger with minimal funding and no outside spending. Markets and fundamentals both point to an easy Republican hold.
model.watch: A late, well-funded outside spending push for Hesketh is the only plausible path to making this competitive.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Eric Burlison, the Republican incumbent, is favored to hold this southwest Missouri seat, which leans heavily Republican by about 21 points. He has raised roughly $1.5 million and holds nearly $1 million on hand, while Democrat Missi Hesketh has raised only about $50,000 and shows no outside spending support. A Libertarian is also on the ballot.

Prediction markets give Burlison roughly a 95 percent chance of winning, and no expert raters flag the race as competitive. With no public polling available, the forecast rests on the district's fundamentals, the incumbent's financial dominance, and the challenger's minimal campaign resources, all pointing to a comfortable Republican victory.
